profile.name: Sagar Kumar Jha
profile.bio: I build robust systems, developer tools, and low-level software from first principles. Currently exploring version control internals, content-addressable storage, and systems programming in modern C++.

minigit.title: MiniGit
minigit.description: A Git-compatible distributed version control system implemented from first principles in modern C++20. Features SHA-256 content-addressable storage, Eugene Myers' $O(ND)$ diff calculation, two-phase staging index, packfile delta compression, and Git Smart HTTP wire synchronization.
highlights: SHA-256 Content-Addressable Storage (CAS) with flattened immutable object trees
Eugene Myers' dynamic programming $O(ND)$ diff algorithm with visual patch inspection
Bounded packfile delta chains ($O(1)$ unpack) and wire-compatible Git Smart HTTP v1 client
Automated cross-platform releases and pre-compiled native binaries for Windows, Linux, and macOS

codeshelf.title: CodeShelf
codeshelf.description: Developer snippet and knowledge management system spanning desktop, VS Code extension, and web. Local-first workspace with technology normalization, weighted lexical search, Myers diff revision history, and optional Gemini AI autofill.
highlights: Local-first atomic disk storage (~/.codeshelf/) with bidirectional desktop-to-IDE synchronization
Weighted lexical search, prefix filters (lang:, tag:, domain:), and technology taxonomy normalization
Automatic revision snapshotting with visual Myers diff rollback and compressed JSON exports
Cross-platform releases across Windows (NSIS), macOS (DMG), Linux (AppImage/deb), and VS Code Marketplace

portfolio-web.title: Config-Driven Portfolio
portfolio-web.description: High-performance, 100% config-driven developer portfolio and technical blog built with Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, and Tailwind CSS v4. Features an interactive terminal CLI, Mermaid diagram canvas modal, and automated GitHub CI sync.

next-mdx-starter.title: Next.js MDX Starter Template
next-mdx-starter.description: Production-ready, reusable full-stack starter template built with Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, Biome, shadcn/ui, Radix UI, and first-class @next/mdx support.
